system.description:
Attack Action: every enemy within Medium Range (50 ft) makes a CR 2 Heart Check; those that fail become Afraid and flee out of that range. Until your next Combat Turn, an enemy must pass a Heart Check with CR equal to your CR to target you.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.53

automation.note: Target every enemy within 50 ft before using this. Enemies that fail flee beyond 50 ft. Until your next Combat Turn, an enemy must pass a Heart Check with CR equal to your CR before it can target you.
